features.title: Persistent versioned 3D project assets
features.entry_point: Open project → Video & automation → Workflow builder → Project-owned 3D originals → Import 3D original

acceptance_checks.description: Import immutable source bytes, persist UUID/hash/units/frame/transform/calibration/review revisions, and exchange or reject tampered assets.

source.description: Project-scoped immutable source bytes, UUID/SHA binding, path and metadata integrity, append-only calibration-review replay, malformed/empty/oversized rejection, and tamper rejection are covered by focused backend tests.

Additive b14_spatial_0040 stores append-only unit, frame, affine transform, calibration, local review, predecessor, source-hash, and integrity-hash metadata revisions while keeping authentication and verification flags false.

Every import queues a durable bounded structural parse job; valid mesh and point-cloud results remain explicitly uncalibrated/unreviewed, malformed and altered originals fail closed, duplicate imports deduplicate, and result hashes reject local or archive tampering.

Project Exchange round-trip remaps spatial source/review/metadata/parse UUIDs, restores verified original bytes, recomputes remapped evidence hashes, requires originals, and rejects altered bytes, review evidence, metadata evidence, or parse results.

browser.description: Normal project navigation exposes project-owned import, background structural parse status/QC, and append-only unit/frame metadata controls inside Workflow builder; focused UI tests exercise the path without a new top-level tab.

windows_installed.description: Exact-SHA disposable Windows clean-install and published 1.0.3-upgrade runs passed schema migration, project persistence/restart, Project Exchange, uninstall, and data retention for 1.4.0; packaged UI inspection separately confirmed project-owned import and metadata/preview controls.

features.notes: Immutable originals, durable bounded background structural parsing, append-only calibration-review and general metadata revisions, and Project Exchange are persistent and integrity-checked. Scientific verification remains confined to the separate blocked entries.

features.notes: Verified on deterministic synthetic geometry. Geometry descriptors remain distinct from biological condition and a generic surface route remains distinct from anatomical branch length.
